title: Cheapest Flights Within K Stops
oneLinerQuestion: Find the cheapest price from a source to destination city with at most K flight stops.
explanation: Bellman-Ford Algorithm executed for k + 1 iterations. Update shortest distances array copying previous iteration state to respect stop constraints.
pseudoCode:
FUNCTION findCheapestPrice(n, flights, src, dst, k):
    prices = ARRAY_OF_SIZE(n, INFINITY)
    prices[src] = 0
    FOR i FROM 0 TO k DO:
        tmpPrices = COPY(prices)
        FOR s, d, p IN flights DO:
            IF prices[s] == INFINITY THEN CONTINUE
            IF prices[s] + p < tmpPrices[d] THEN tmpPrices[d] = prices[s] + p
        END FOR
        prices = tmpPrices
    END FOR
    RETURN prices[dst] != INFINITY ? prices[dst] : -1
END FUNCTION
